title: כאן, עכשיו
emotional_truth: most of life is missed while we're somewhere else in our heads; presence is the smallest way to get it back

forbidden: forcing focus in a way that feels like a test
any framing that treats distraction as a flaw to fix
safety.notes: A wandering mind is normal, not a failure. Presence is a gentle return, not a performance. Success is the noticing and the return, never how long attention held.
